# opnsense_dyndns_account (Data Source)

Reads a dynamic DNS account configuration from OPNsense.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Look up a dyndns account by its UUID
data "opnsense_dyndns_account" "example" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "current_ip" {
  value = data.opnsense_dyndns_account.example.current_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

### Read-Only

- `checkip` (String) The service used for checking the current public IP address.
- `checkip_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for the IP check service.
- `current_ip` (String) The current IP address reported by the dynamic DNS service.
- `current_mtime` (String) The last modification time of the current IP address.
- `description` (String) Description for this dynamic DNS account.
- `dyn_ipv6_host` (String) The IPv6 host for dynamic DNS.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this dynamic DNS account is enabled.
- `force_ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL is forced for dynamic DNS updates.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Set of hostnames to update.
- `interface` (String) The interface monitored for IP changes.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for authentication with the dynamic DNS service. Not returned by the API; always null.
- `protocol` (String) The dynamic DNS protocol.
- `resource_id` (String) The resource identifier for the dynamic DNS service.
- `server` (String) The server hostname or URL for the dynamic DNS service.
- `service` (String) The dynamic DNS service type.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL value for the DNS record.
- `username` (String) Username for authentication with the dynamic DNS service.
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether wildcard DNS record is enabled.
- `zone` (String) The DNS zone for the dynamic DNS record.
